Planar XY E2 equals E3 for every h when N even or N=3, but for odd N>=5 is strictly greater iff 0<h<h_s. For odd N, E2=-NJc_N-Nh^2/[8Jc_N(1+c_N)]+O(h^3) near zero, giving chi_XY/chi_3D=1/(2c_N).
